answer: Require every new identity to pass a live, unscripted onboarding session with a rotating panel of established members: the panel issues fresh, unpredictable prompts and judges coherence in real time. Like tending a garden, each saffron shoot must be inspected individually; one gardener cannot clone the visit. A jade seal is granted only after the session, and panelists' attention is scarce, so each extra fake identity costs a full fresh session that cannot be replayed, shared, or run in parallel.
